paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Gurion. The sages allotted his daughter five hundred dinars for a basket of perfumes each day, though she was only a woman awaiting levirate marriage. Nevertheless, she cursed them: “May you give this much to your daughters!” R' Aha said, “We answered Amen after her.” R' Elazar said, “I saw her tied to a horse's tail”: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Af al Pi. It appears that this R' Elazar is R' Elazar son of R' Tzadok, who reports a similar incident there. That passage names R' Elazar son of R' Tzadok. So it appears explicitly in the Jerusalem Talmud: R' Elazar ben Tzadok.
